ontario-mines-permis-exploration-baux-in.sourceTitle: L’Ontario propose un permis unique pour explorer plusieurs terrains miniers
ontario-mines-permis-exploration-baux-in.sourceSummary: La province veut simplifier les démarches des prospecteurs et remettre des terrains à disposition lorsque des baux demeurent inutilisés. La définition d’un bail inactif reste à préciser.
ontario-mines-permis-exploration-baux-in.title: Ontario proposes a single permit for exploration across multiple mining properties
ontario-mines-permis-exploration-baux-in.summary: The province wants to simplify applications for prospectors and free up land held under unused leases. It has yet to define when a lease qualifies as inactive.
ontario-mines-permis-exploration-baux-in.body:
A company that wishes to look for minerals on several separate plots of land must now apply for separate permits. Ontario wants to allow it to consolidate these lands into a single application. Energy and Mines Minister Stephen Lecce presented the proposal on November 24 at a critical minerals forum in Toronto. The government intends to file legislation within days of the announcement.

The change would affect the early stages of a project, as companies are still looking to determine what the basement contains. Preliminary exploration plans would remain valid for three years, compared to two currently. For a prospector working on separate terrain, the new device would therefore reduce both the number of applications and the frequency of certain renewals.

The second part is for companies that already have a mining lease. The province proposes to refuse the renewal of leases left inactive in order to make the corresponding public lands accessible to other companies. According to the ministry, less than half of the leases are subject to a plan or exploration permit. In The Northern Miner, journalist Blair McBride notes that the minister has not explained how Ontario will distinguish a truly abandoned ground from a project that requires several years of preparation.

The ministry also wants to give inspectors more means of intervention, including field orders and administrative financial penalties. According to The Northern Miner, the proposals aim to extend the simplification of authorizations beyond the four major projects already admitted to the provincial accelerated processing system. The next step will be the submission of the text, which will allow for a review of the specific conditions of the new permits and the renewal of the leases.

dany-laferriere-prix-athanase-david-2026.sourceTitle: Le Québec décerne le prix Athanase-David à Dany Laferrière
dany-laferriere-prix-athanase-david-2026.sourceSummary: Cinquante ans après son arrivée à Montréal, l’écrivain né à Port-au-Prince reçoit la plus haute distinction littéraire du gouvernement québécois. Trois livres donnent la mesure du trajet parcouru.
dany-laferriere-prix-athanase-david-2026.title: Quebec awards the Prix Athanase-David to Dany Laferrière
dany-laferriere-prix-athanase-david-2026.summary: Fifty years after arriving in Montreal from Port-au-Prince, the writer has received Quebec’s highest literary honour. Three of his books trace the course of his career.
dany-laferriere-prix-athanase-david-2026.body:
In 1976, a young journalist from Port-au-Prince arrived in Montreal. He was 23 years old and worked in a factory before publishing his first novel in 1985. Fifty years after his arrival, Dany Laferrière received the Athanase-David Prize. The Government of Quebec presented him with this distinction on November 24, with a scholarship of $30,000. It recognizes a career spanning some forty titles.

To explore his work, we can start with a phone call. In The Enigma of Return, the narrator learns that his father died in New York. The funeral then led him to return to Haiti, thirty-three years after his departure. By mixing the narrative with the brevity of the haiku, the book gives a form to the intervals of exile. He won the Medici Prize in 2009.

A year later, the writing is a testimony. With Tout bouges around me, Laferrière reports the earthquake of January 12, 2010 in Port-au-Prince by observing the gestures of those who try to continue their lives. In 2018, it changes support. In Autoportrait de Paris with Chat, his first novel drawn, writing and the line share the page.

Another episode says traffic between these cities. On December 12, 2013, the day when the French Academy elected him to the number two chair, Laferrière is in Port-au-Prince, where he talks about literature to young people. Quebec honors it this week for books that have made their readers travel both ways, from Montreal to Haiti and from Haiti to Montreal.

ukraine-hongrie-oujhorod-energie-frontie.sourceTitle: En Transcarpatie, Kyiv et Budapest rouvrent les dossiers du diesel et du rail
ukraine-hongrie-oujhorod-energie-frontie.sourceSummary: Volodymyr Zelensky et Péter Magyar ont discuté le 24 novembre de livraisons de carburant, de liaisons ferroviaires et des droits de la minorité hongroise. Le rapprochement touche aussi les négociations européennes de l’Ukraine.
ukraine-hongrie-oujhorod-energie-frontie.title: Ukraine and Hungary reopen talks on diesel supplies and rail links in Transcarpathia
ukraine-hongrie-oujhorod-energie-frontie.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky and Péter Magyar discussed fuel deliveries, rail connections and the rights of the Hungarian minority on November 24. The renewed talks also bear on Ukraine’s negotiations with the European Union.
ukraine-hongrie-oujhorod-energie-frontie.body:
Long a source of tension between Kyiv and Budapest, the Ukrainian region of Transcarpathia welcomed on November 24, 2026 the first official visit of Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar to Ukraine since coming to power. At the Heroes’ Cemetery in Uzhhorod, Péter Magyar and Volodymyr Zelensky paid tribute to the soldiers killed during the war. They then spoke in Berehove, where they discussed diesel deliveries and rail links between the two countries.

On energy, the two neighbors each have something to offer. According to Reuters, this year Hungary resumed diesel exports to Ukraine that the previous government had suspended. Leaders discussed an increase in deliveries. Hungarian companies could, for their part, make more use of Ukrainian gas storage facilities. No additional fuel volume was announced at the end of the meeting.

For the rail, the Ukrainian presidency cited the link between Kyiv and Budapest, the electrification of the tracks and the modernization of existing border crossings. The two leaders also discussed the opening of new crossing points. These files remain to be made concrete. The visit did not result in any announcement of commissioning of a line.

The meeting also brought together two political discussions that the inhabitants of the region are familiar with. In October, the Ukrainian Parliament expanded the rights of minorities to receive education in their language. Budapest then raised its objections to the opening of European negotiations on the internal market and competitiveness, Reuters reports. In Transcarpathia, Péter Magyar defended the possibility for members of the Hungarian community to speak their language in hospital or in social services. The two leaders also met with students and teachers in Berehove.

cop31-antalya-fossiles-adaptation.sourceTitle: À la COP31, le pacte d’Antalya échoue sur les énergies fossiles et le financement
cop31-antalya-fossiles-adaptation.sourceSummary: Le sommet climatique s’est achevé le 22 novembre sans accord sur les deux textes proposés par sa présidence. Les délégations ont toutefois prolongé le travail sur la transition juste et précisé comment mesurer l’adaptation.
cop31-antalya-fossiles-adaptation.title: At COP31, the Antalya pact falls short on fossil fuels and financing
cop31-antalya-fossiles-adaptation.summary: The climate summit ended on November 22 without agreement on the presidency’s two proposed texts. Delegates extended work on the just transition and clarified how to measure adaptation.
cop31-antalya-fossiles-adaptation.body:
In Antalya, delegations extended negotiations almost two days beyond the scheduled closing time. On the evening of Sunday, November 22, 2026, several countries maintained their objections. The Turkish presidency of COP31 closed the session without having the two texts adopted, which together were to constitute the Antalya pact.

The Earth Negotiations Bulletin describes the disagreement. For the European Union, the lack of reference to fossil fuels made the text unacceptable. The Marshall Islands and Vanuatu have also challenged the place given to technologies that, in their view, would allow the use of these fuels to continue. Several delegations recalled that countries had already recognized the need to move away from fossil fuels during the first global review of the Paris Agreement.

Funding has generated another debate. The African group noted that calling for a tripling of adaptation funding without setting a starting amount made the commitment difficult to verify. Despite this objection, he said he was ready to accept the compromise. The least developed countries felt that the proposals allowed them to bear an excessive part of the effort.

Other decisions adopted in Antalya will have an effect on the work of the coming years. The programme on the just transition, which examines in particular the consequences of economic change for the populations concerned, is extended by three years. Countries testing the 59 adaptation indicators established in Belém will be able to pool their challenges. A working group must specify the calculation methods. The conference also launched the second global review of the Paris Agreement, the group exercise that should inform future national commitments.

onu-feminicides-proches-estimations-2025.sourceTitle: En 2025, environ 47 000 femmes et filles ont été tuées par un partenaire ou un membre de leur famille
onu-feminicides-proches-estimations-2025.sourceSummary: ONU Femmes et l’Office des Nations unies contre la drogue et le crime ont publié le 24 novembre leur estimation mondiale. Les changements dans les données disponibles compliquent la comparaison d’une année à l’autre.
onu-feminicides-proches-estimations-2025.title: An estimated 47,000 women and girls were killed by a partner or family member in 2025
onu-feminicides-proches-estimations-2025.summary: UN Women and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime published their global estimates on November 24. Changes in the available data complicate year-to-year comparisons.
onu-feminicides-proches-estimations-2025.body:
On average, 129 women or girls were killed every day in 2025 by an intimate partner or family member. UN Women and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime released the report on 24 November 2026 on the eve of the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. Their estimate is based on statistics from 122 countries and territories.

Of the approximately 78,000 women and girls who were victims of intentional homicide in 2025 worldwide, about 60% were killed by a person in this close circle. The corresponding share among men who have been killed is 11%. For organizations, this gap indicates where the prevention of violence must also be carried, beyond couples alone. Threats must be identified and victims protected when the perpetrator belongs to the extended family.

A quick comparison with the previous balance sheet could be misleading. For 2024, the two agencies had put forward the figure of 50,000 victims killed by a relative. They attribute the gap with the estimated 47,000 for 2025 mainly to the evolution of the data available in the countries. These two figures, taken in isolation, therefore do not make it possible to conclude that the risk has decreased.

Reported to the female population, the estimate reaches 2.9 victims per 100,000 women and girls in Africa and 1.4 in the Americas. Another limitation is crimes committed outside the family circle. Women and girls may also be killed because of their gender in trafficked or organized crime settings. In the absence of sufficient data, the United Nations indicates that it remains impossible to establish a comparable regional or global balance sheet.

intensite-energetique-2026-economies-con.sourceTitle: Pourquoi le monde devrait utiliser moins d’énergie par unité de richesse en 2026
intensite-energetique-2026-economies-con.sourceSummary: L’Agence internationale de l’énergie prévoit une baisse de près de 3 % de l’intensité énergétique mondiale. Son rapport distingue les gains techniques des réductions de consommation imposées par les pénuries et les prix.
intensite-energetique-2026-economies-con.title: Why the global economy is expected to use less energy per unit of output in 2026
intensite-energetique-2026-economies-con.summary: The International Energy Agency expects global energy intensity to decline by nearly 3%. Its report distinguishes efficiency gains from cuts in consumption driven by shortages and high prices.
intensite-energetique-2026-economies-con.body:
To produce the same economic value, the world is expected to need nearly 3% less primary energy in 2026. The decline reached about 2% in 2025. This acceleration, estimated by the International Energy Agency (IEA) in a report published on 23 November, is partly due to a gap between activity and consumption. Total energy demand would remain close to last year’s level, while global gross domestic product would grow by about 3%.

A heat pump in a well-insulated house can maintain comfort while using less energy. A plant that reduces its production because gas is too expensive also lowers consumption, with a cost for activity. The same global indicator mixes these situations. The IEA observes the effects of disturbances from the Strait of Hormuz to the kitchens of Asian households, where gas shortages have forced some families to change fuel.

Global electricity demand is expected to increase by about 3.6% in 2026, according to the agency. The electrification of transport contributes to this, as do data centers and advanced industries. In North America, the IEA anticipates an improvement in energy intensity of 2%, close to the average rate observed since the beginning of the decade.

The effects of old investments give a point of comparison. According to an estimate by the European Commission communicated to Reuters on 23 November, efficiency measures introduced between 2015 and 2021 would have saved the European Union about 120 billion euros of oil and gas imports between February 2022 and mid-2026. These savings have accumulated over more than four years. The global balance sheet of 2026 remains an annual estimate that still incorporates the deprivations related to the crisis.

bepicolombo-orbite-mercure-freinage.sourceTitle: BepiColombo atteint Mercure sur une orbite de 75 heures, contre 58 prévues
bepicolombo-orbite-mercure-freinage.sourceSummary: Un incident logiciel a écourté le freinage de la sonde européenne et japonaise. L’Agence spatiale européenne confirme que son orbite est stable et maintient la séparation des deux appareils scientifiques en décembre.
bepicolombo-orbite-mercure-freinage.title: BepiColombo enters a 75-hour orbit around Mercury, longer than the planned 58 hours
bepicolombo-orbite-mercure-freinage.summary: A software incident cut short the joint European-Japanese spacecraft’s braking manoeuvre. The European Space Agency says its orbit is stable and still plans to separate the two science orbiters in December.
bepicolombo-orbite-mercure-freinage.body:
On November 21, 635 kilometers from the surface of Mercury, BepiColombo fired its four thrusters to slow the spacecraft after eight years of travel. The burn was scheduled to last 37 minutes. When the flight controllers in Darmstadt, Germany, found the signal after a planned interruption, the craft had entered safe mode. The probe had achieved only 77% of the targeted shift.

The signal made it possible to reconnect. It remained to be seen whether the thrust was sufficient to keep the probe in orbit. The analysis of the data confirmed its capture by Mercury. In its assessment of 23 November, the European Space Agency (ESA) attributes the premature shutdown of the engines to a software incident. The period of its orbit is 75 hours, against the 58 planned.

The engineers had planned several successive braking. With each passage closer to Mercury, a short thrust allows to modify the trajectory by saving the fuel. The measurement of the obtained orbit is used to calculate the following maneuver. ESA announces that it has adjusted the sequence to the new trajectory without adding ignition to the program.

Both aircraft still travel assembled. Their separation remains scheduled for December 9, European time, the 10th in Japan. The European orbiter will study the surface and internal structure of the planet. Mio, built by the Japanese space agency, will measure the magnetic field and its environment. Among the rocky planets of the Solar System, Mercury shares with the Earth the particularity of possessing a global magnetic field produced inside the planet. Regular scientific observations of both machines are scheduled to begin in April 2027.

photo.sourceCaption: Vue d’artiste de l’insertion de BepiColombo en orbite autour de Mercure, le 21 novembre 2026. Les deux orbiteurs sont encore assemblés pendant le freinage.

iowa-middletown-departs-temporaires-deto.sourceTitle: En Iowa, les habitants de Middletown se préparent à une détonation contrôlée
iowa-middletown-departs-temporaires-deto.sourceSummary: L’armée américaine prévoit de détruire un stock d’explosif dégradé ce mercredi 25 novembre vers 9 h en Iowa, soit 10 h à Toronto. Le risque de dispersion de poussières de plomb a conduit les autorités à recommander des départs temporaires.
iowa-middletown-departs-temporaires-deto.title: Middletown residents prepare for a controlled detonation in Iowa
iowa-middletown-departs-temporaires-deto.summary: The U.S. military scheduled the disposal of deteriorating explosives for Wednesday, November 25, at about 9 a.m. local time, or 10 a.m. in Toronto. The potential spread of lead dust prompted authorities to advise residents to leave temporarily.
iowa-middletown-departs-temporaires-deto.body:
In Middletown, southeast Iowa, residents spent part of Tuesday caulking their doors and windows. Shops planned to close Wednesday, the day before Thanksgiving, reports the Associated Press on the spot. The small town is preparing for the destruction of a stockpile of lead azide that has become unstable at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant. According to the U.S. military, waiting more would expose the population to the risk of an accidental explosion.

For local residents, the concern goes beyond the sound of detonation. Dust containing lead could be driven by the wind and deposited beyond the site. On Tuesday night, the Illinois Environmental Protection Agency said the available forecast placed its state out of the expected trajectory. This forecast depends on the weather. In Iowa, authorities are reviewing the planned monitoring system for air, soil and water.

Governor Kim Reynolds has declared a state of emergency in Des Moines, Lee and Van Buren counties. The state has identified about 150 households to contact to provide instructions and offer assistance. Departures are recommended in the relevant sectors. FEMA, the federal emergency management agency, offers transport, meals and temporary accommodation. Relocated people must be notified by phone when they can return home.

At 1 a.m., Toronto time, the operation remained scheduled for 9 a.m. in Iowa. The army specified that the final time would depend on the weather conditions. The announcements were therefore still about the precautions taken before the operation.

photo.sourceCaption: Robert Cekada, directeur de l’ATF, prend la parole à Middletown le 24 novembre 2026 lors du point de presse sur l’opération à l’Iowa Army Ammunition Plant.

cap-vert-presidentielle-neves-abstention.sourceTitle: Au Cap-Vert, José Maria Neves réélu au premier tour sur fond d’abstention record
cap-vert-presidentielle-neves-abstention.sourceSummary: La Commission nationale des élections a proclamé les résultats le 21 novembre. Le président sortant recueille 63,96 % des suffrages valides, alors que moins d’un électeur inscrit sur trois a voté.
cap-vert-presidentielle-neves-abstention.title: Cape Verde re-elects José Maria Neves in the first round as turnout hits a record low
cap-vert-presidentielle-neves-abstention.summary: The National Elections Commission announced the results on November 21. The incumbent received 63.96% of valid votes. Fewer than one in three registered voters cast a ballot.
cap-vert-presidentielle-neves-abstention.body:
Cape Verde has reappointed José Maria Neves to the presidency for a second five-year term. The National Elections Commission declared victory on 21 November 2026 in Praia, the day after the end of the general recount. Six candidates were running for election on November 15. The outgoing president won 82,621 votes, more than double the 40,568 votes won by Joana Rosa, who came second with 31.40% of the valid votes.

This result contrasts with that of participation. Of the 419,532 people on the lists, 132,883 voted. The electoral law requires an absolute majority of the valid votes cast for a candidate to win in the first round. White ballots are excluded from this calculation. With 63.96% of the valid votes, Neves crossed the required threshold. By counting all registered voters, their score is just under one in five people.

The participation gap between the archipelago and its diaspora is reflected in the accounts of the commission. In the country, 118,617 registered out of 343,080 voted, or about 35%. Abroad, the proportion drops to less than 19%, with 14,266 voters for 76,452 registered. The Cape Verdean newspaper A Nação notes that the national abstention of 68.33 % is the highest recorded in a presidential election in the country.

On the very evening of the vote, Neves had called on political actors to study the reasons for this weak mobilization. According to A Nação, he proposed to start by updating the electoral rolls to better know the number of voters. He also pledged to represent the Cape Verdeans of the islands as well as those of the diaspora and to cooperate with the government in accordance with the competences of each.

tunnel-la-fontaine-retour-deux-voies-dec.sourceTitle: Québec prévoit de rouvrir une deuxième voie vers la Rive-Sud dans le tunnel La Fontaine le 14 décembre
tunnel-la-fontaine-retour-deux-voies-dec.sourceSummary: Avant la réouverture prévue, la circulation vers Montréal doit changer de tube. La fin de semaine du 27 novembre sera particulièrement contraignante pour les usagers de l’autoroute 25.
tunnel-la-fontaine-retour-deux-voies-dec.title: Quebec plans to reopen a second southbound lane in the La Fontaine tunnel on December 14
tunnel-la-fontaine-retour-deux-voies-dec.summary: Montreal-bound traffic will switch to the other tunnel tube before the reopening. Highway 25 users face particular disruption over the weekend of November 27.
tunnel-la-fontaine-retour-deux-voies-dec.body:
For motorists who leave Montreal via the Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine tunnel, the expected change is primarily about the return journey. They currently have a single lane to the South Shore. Quebec plans to open a second on Monday, December 14. Both lanes to Montreal will be maintained. The Department of Transport and Sustainable Mobility announced this schedule on November 23 and updated its traffic advisories the following day.

Two operations are on the calendar. On November 30, traffic to Montreal must be transferred to the renovated tube, with the same number of lanes as today. It will take another two weeks before the capacity increases in the other direction. EST MÉDIA Montréal, which follows the construction site in the east of the island, locates the closures necessary for these two operations between November 27 and December 14.

The first weekend illustrates the difference between the two journeys. Toward Montreal, the ministry plans to completely close the section of Highway 25 which includes the tunnel, from Friday, November 27 to 11 p.m. to Monday, November 30 at 5 a.m. Towards the South Shore, the announced closures are concentrated at night. Detailed schedules, which may change with the conditions of the construction site, are included in the provincial notice.

The re-commissioning of the six lanes will await the reconstruction of the central ground floor of the highway near the tunnel. Quebec is aiming for summer 2027 for this stage. The ministry then plans finishing and development work until the end of the fall. In the meantime, access to the city centre from Highway 25 north remains indicated by exit 3.

amazon-leo-400-satellites-ariane-6.sourceTitle: Amazon franchit le cap des 400 satellites déployés pour son réseau Internet Leo
amazon-leo-400-satellites-ariane-6.sourceSummary: Ariane 6 a placé 36 satellites en orbite le 24 novembre depuis la Guyane française. Avant de relayer des connexions, ils doivent encore gagner près de 170 kilomètres d’altitude et passer leurs essais.
amazon-leo-400-satellites-ariane-6.title: Amazon Leo reaches 400 satellites deployed for its internet network
amazon-leo-400-satellites-ariane-6.summary: An Ariane 6 launched 36 satellites from French Guiana on November 24. They must climb another 170 kilometres and complete testing before they can provide internet service.
amazon-leo-400-satellites-ariane-6.body:
Tuesday at 8:14 a.m., Kourou time, an Ariane 6 with four boosters took off with 36 satellites from Amazon’s Internet network. Two hours and four minutes later, the last satellite separated from the launch vehicle. With this delivery, Amazon says it has deployed more than 400 devices since the start of the large-scale implementation of its constellation, in April 2025. Arianespace transported 136 during four missions.

Some 460 kilometers above Earth, the launcher’s teams passed the hand at Amazon’s control center in Redmond, Washington. Operators must establish contact with the satellites, check the state of the systems and make them rise to their working orbit, 630 kilometers. The figure put forward Tuesday therefore measures the deployed aircraft. For a household that is waiting for access to the Internet, the availability of the service also depends on the operation of the network.

The succession of the last two flights shows how much the schedule of such a network depends on a few hours of launch. On November 15, a United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket lost a charge of 40 Leo satellites. Nine days later, Ariane delivered almost as much from another continent. Amazon has booked flights with several operators to eventually serve areas poorly covered by terrestrial networks.

After an additional order for six flights in September, the contract between Amazon and Arianespace now has 24 missions. For the European launcher, who had made his tenth flight on Tuesday since his debut in 2024, this contract provides the opportunity to repeat the same industrial operation. For Amazon, the step that will bring these 36 satellites closer to users will be played in space, at the end of their rise and their commissioning.

canada-recettes-fermes-canola-neuf-mois.sourceTitle: Les fermes canadiennes encaissent 79,7 milliards de dollars en neuf mois, portées par le canola
canada-recettes-fermes-canola-neuf-mois.sourceSummary: Les recettes brutes de janvier à septembre progressent de 7,7 % sur un an. La Saskatchewan enregistre la plus forte hausse en dollars, tandis que le Québec et l’Ontario avancent à un rythme plus modéré.
canada-recettes-fermes-canola-neuf-mois.title: Canola helps push Canadian farm cash receipts to $79.7 billion in nine months
canada-recettes-fermes-canola-neuf-mois.summary: Farm cash receipts from January to September rose 7.7% year over year. Saskatchewan posted the largest dollar increase, while receipts in Quebec and Ontario grew more slowly.
canada-recettes-fermes-canola-neuf-mois.body:
Canola alone accounts for about three in five dollars in the increase in Canadian agricultural revenues since the beginning of the year. Producers cashed in 3.4 billion dollars more for this oilseed from January to September 2026 than in the same months of 2025. Across the country, including all farm products and support payments, the increase is 5.7 billion, according to data released on November 24 by Statistics Canada.

Producers have sold both more canola and received a better price. The quantities marketed increased by 28.4%, and prices by 7.6%. In cattle farming, the movement was different. The quantities sold fell slightly, but the rise in prices allowed farmers to cash 1.4 billion dollars more.

The comparison by province gives an idea of the distribution of these gains. In Saskatchewan, revenues increased by 2.1 billion dollars. Ontario farms have cashed in total of 17.9 billion, up 5.3%. In Quebec, the total reached nearly 10.4 billion, or 3.6% more in a year. In Alberta, Canada News Media has recalculated the amounts from the federal quarterly table. The province alone accounts for about a quarter of Canada's revenues, even after a decrease in its direct payments to farms.

What remains once fuel, inputs and other charges are paid? This series measures the money received by farms, in current dollars, before expenses. The nine months of revenue therefore give a reading of the sales and aids that have entered the boxes. To find out about the net farm income of 2026, Statistics Canada plans to release its first estimates on May 26, 2027.

canada-prix-personnalises-donnees-consom.sourceTitle: Le commissaire fédéral réclame plus de transparence sur les prix personnalisés
canada-prix-personnalises-donnees-consom.sourceSummary: Philippe Dufresne prépare des orientations sur les prix calculés à partir de renseignements personnels. Devant les députés, le Bureau de la concurrence a aussi soulevé la question des logiciels partagés par des concurrents.
canada-prix-personnalises-donnees-consom.title: Federal commissioner calls for greater transparency on personalized pricing
canada-prix-personnalises-donnees-consom.summary: Philippe Dufresne is preparing guidance on the use of personal information to set prices. In testimony before MPs, the Competition Bureau also raised questions about competitors using the same software.
canada-prix-personnalises-donnees-consom.body:
How can a customer know if the price they see depends on what a business knows about them? Before a House of Commons committee, on November 23 in Ottawa, the federal privacy commissioner, Philippe Dufresne, announced a consultation on personalized offers by algorithm. His office wants to clarify in 2027 how companies should explain this practice and obtain informed consent.

Two people can see a different price for many reasons. When a large event attracts visitors to a city, for example, the demand can raise the room rate for the entire customer base. The Commissioner is interested in another situation, where information about an individual or the group to which he or she belongs is used to calculate the price presented to him. According to the report of The Canadian Press, he wants the customer to be informed even if the adjustment is worth a discount.

At this stage, the hearing informs mainly about the difficulty of identifying the phenomenon. M. Dufresne told members that his office had not received any complaints about this. To file a complaint, the customer would still need to know that his data played in the offer he received.

The Competition Bureau, heard on the same day, is interested in the effects of these tools on business-to-business relations. Competitors who use the same software provider could, in some circumstances, more easily coordinate their prices. The Bureau recalls that automation also has common uses, for example to adjust prices to available stocks. It examines the conduct of companies and its effects on competition. The consultation announced by the Commissioner will focus on the use of personal information in the calculation of an individual price.

alexandrie-fondations-quartier-royal.sourceTitle: À Alexandrie, des fondations monumentales ravivent la piste d’un tombeau royal
alexandrie-fondations-quartier-royal.sourceSummary: Dans les jardins de Shallalat, une mission grecque a dégagé les fondations carrées d’un vaste bâtiment. Un comité égyptien examine sa possible fonction funéraire. L’identité du monument reste à établir.
alexandrie-fondations-quartier-royal.title: Monumental foundations in Alexandria renew interest in the search for a royal tomb
alexandrie-fondations-quartier-royal.summary: In the Shallalat Gardens, a Greek team has uncovered the square foundations of a large building. An Egyptian committee is examining whether it had a funerary purpose. The monument’s identity remains unknown.
alexandrie-fondations-quartier-royal.body:
Under the Shallalat Gardens in Alexandria, walls surround the limestone foundations of a square building. A tunnel passes under the building and heads north. These remains, presented on November 24 in the Egyptian press, allow archaeologists to locate an imposing monument in the royal district of the ancient city. What was this building for? The first clues point to one possibility.

The Greek mission led by Calliope Limneos-Papakosta has been searching the area for about twenty years. After the submission of its report, the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities convened a committee including specialists from the universities of Alexandria and Tanta. These researchers examined the site. The shape and scale of the foundations make them consider a high-rise building. They study the hypothesis of a funerary function and a possible link with the royal monument associated with Ptolemy IV, which reigned from 221 to 204 BCE.

The written sources explain the interest of this track. In his Geography, Strabo describes a set of palaces connected to each other and to the port. He locates a enclosure called Sêma, which, according to his account, housed the burials of kings and that of Alexander the Great. This text situates a monumental ensemble in the ancient city. It does not make it possible to attribute the Masonry of Shallalat to a specific sovereign.

The excavations have already delivered in the area sections of a royal Hellenistic road and a large Roman street, documented by the Museum of Antiquities of the Bibliotheca Alexandrina. Following the walls and the tunnel should help researchers to replace the building in relation to these roads and nearby constructions. Its dating and function remain the two questions to be solved before it can be identified.

photo.sourceCaption: Cette statue de marbre a été mise au jour le 4 mai 2009 dans les jardins de Shallalat, à Alexandrie. L’archéologue Calliope Limneos Papakosta l’a photographiée à sa découverte puis avant sa restauration.

photo.caption: This marble statue was uncovered on May 4, 2009 in the Shallalat Gardens in Alexandria. Archaeologist Calliope Limneos Papakosta photographed her to discover her and before her restoration.

f1-grand-prix-qatar-verstappen-mclaren.sourceTitle: Au Qatar, Red Bull défend neuf points d’avance sur McLaren
f1-grand-prix-qatar-verstappen-mclaren.sourceSummary: Le titre pilotes et celui des constructeurs sont déjà attribués. Le Grand Prix du Qatar, dimanche à 11 h à Montréal, peut encore changer la hiérarchie derrière Mercedes.
f1-grand-prix-qatar-verstappen-mclaren.title: Red Bull takes a nine-point lead over McLaren into the Qatar Grand Prix
f1-grand-prix-qatar-verstappen-mclaren.summary: The drivers’ and constructors’ titles have been decided. Sunday’s Qatar Grand Prix, at 11 a.m. Montreal time, could still change the order behind Mercedes.
f1-grand-prix-qatar-verstappen-mclaren.body:
Max Verstappen won in Las Vegas, yet McLaren scored more points than Red Bull. That result sets up the Qatar Grand Prix, the penultimate round of the season. According to the presentation published on November 24 by Formula 1, Red Bull holds third place in the constructors’ standings with a nine-point lead over McLaren. Kimi Antonelli has already won the drivers' championship and Mercedes has already won the team championship.

In Nevada on November 21, Verstappen beat Lando Norris by 639 thousandths of a second after 50 laps. The Red Bull driver earned 25 points. But Oscar Piastri, who started 17th, brought his McLaren back to third place. Adding its 15 points to the 18 of Norris, the British team has 33. This double podium alone allowed him to regain eight points from his rival despite the victory of the Dutchman.

Verstappen also defends second place in the individual championship. His U.S. victory gave him a 37-point lead over Lewis Hamilton, according to Reuters. The two rankings give different readings of the same race. Verstappen can widen the gap on Hamilton by arriving in front of him, even on a Sunday where Red Bull gives ground to McLaren in the cumulation of both cars.

In Lulsail, near Doha, the drivers will find a circuit of 5.419 km dominated by fast corners. Three practice sessions are scheduled before the Saturday, November 28 qualifying. The 57 rounds are scheduled to start on Sunday, November 29 at 7 p.m. in Qatar, 11 a.m. in Montreal and Toronto.

notre-methode.sourceTitle: Au-delà des titres : notre engagement pour une information traçable
notre-methode.sourceSummary: Sources, contexte et transparence : les principes qui guident la construction de BYRVOX.
notre-methode.title: Beyond the titles: our commitment to traceable information
notre-methode.summary: Sources, context and transparency: the principles that guide the construction of BYRVOX.
notre-methode.body:
BYRVOX is built around a requirement: allow the reader to understand where information comes from.

Articles published by the editorial staff must present their sources, dates and context. Updates retain a history. Uncertain information should be identified as such.

The platform is currently in the launch phase. No radio or television streams are connected yet.

verification.sourceTitle: Comment BYRVOX vérifie et publie ses articles
verification.sourceSummary: La rédaction valide ses articles dans le portail. Les articles du fil horaire portent la signature de l’agent qui les vérifie et les publie automatiquement.
verification.title: How BYRVOX verifies and publishes its articles
verification.summary: Newsroom staff approve articles prepared in the editor portal. Hourly news stories carry the byline of the agent that checks and publishes them automatically.
verification.body:
In the editor portal, a member of the newsroom checks the facts, dates and sources in a draft before deciding whether to publish it.

For the hourly news feed, the BYRVOX agent cross-checks facts against at least two independent sources and checks earlier coverage to avoid duplicates. It verifies what the photo shows, who should receive credit and whether it may be republished. Once these checks are complete, the agent automatically publishes the story under its own byline with links to its sources.

The newsroom can correct any published article, regardless of how it was produced. The portal keeps a record of each version.
